Mystery, corporate scandal and incredibly dangerous tech--with a lot of lives on the line.|Agent [[Fauler]]|<ref name="timely arrival">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Timely Arrival|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>}}
[[File:FaulerThinks-SWTOR.png|thumb|[[Fauler]] and [[Kamus Orden]] are planning an operation|260x260px]]
An '''operation''' was conducted in [[3643 BBY]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], by a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Republic Strategic Information Service (SIS)]] agent [[Fauler]], who was investigating a possibility of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] having a weapon of mass destruction somewhere on the planet.

==Prelude==
At some point prior to the operation, [[Kamus Orden]], an accountant working for Czerka Corporation, forwarded financial documentation covering old expenses for a billion-credit [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|research facility]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to a Republic security office. The documents revealed that the facility was studying a "type 7 device" - as Czerka designated weapons capable of killing all life on a planet. This caught attention of a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Fauler]]. He traveled to Tatooine under cover of a Republic representative, and stationed at the [[Republic Embassy (Tatooine)|Republic Embassy]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. Kamus joined him there, hoping that the Republic will protect him from Czerka assassins.<ref name="timely arrival" />

At the same time, [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], hoping to prevent the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] from discovering the truth about Czerka's [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|old facility]], sent [[Gayem Leksende]] to the [[Tatooine/Legends|planet]], tasked with stopping the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]], as well as a strike team to find a capture [[Kamus Orden]].<ref name="timely arrival" />

==The course of the operation==
{{GameLSmechanics}}
[[File:CzerkaVsKamus-SWTOR.png|thumb|Czerka strike team finds [[Kamus Orden]] in the basement of the [[Republic Embassy (Tatooine)|Republic Embassy]] |224x224px]]
To find an operative who would be able to venture into the desert, [[Fauler]] sent a droid [[N0-HX]] to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] [[Anchorhead Spaceport|spaceport]]. When an exceptionally skilled Republic spacer arrived to Tatooine, the droid contacted them and established a holo-connection with Fauler, so he could invite the individual to the [[Republic Embassy (Tatooine)|Embassy]]. Fauler however got delayed by his diplomatic duties and the spacer came to the Embassy first, finding [[Kamus Orden]] attacked by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] infiltrators inside the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] safehouse in the basement of the Embassy. Czerka's [[Unidentified Czerka strike team leader|strike team leader]] ordered his men to kill an intruding spacer as well, and a confrontation followed in which all Czerka officers were killed. Kamus Orden thanked spacer for the rescue, and Fauler finally arrived, allowing all three to introduce themselves. Impressed by spacer's fighting skills displayed in fight against Czerka strike team, Fauler hired them to assist him in the operation.<ref name="timely arrival" />

Fauler then sent his new associate to [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], to gather Czerka's data from an old and presumably abandoned  [[Jundland Czerka facility|Czerka compound]]. However, Czerka got there first and made a deal with a local [[Shurg's Gamorrean clan|band]] of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], so spacer met a heavy opposition. They eventually succeeded in dispatching enemy forces, killed Gammorean warlord [[Shurg]] and Czerka [[Unidentified Czerka security commander|security commander]], securing the data for the SIS. The data included a list of all Czerka employees who worked on the [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|project]] on Tatooine, and the last of them to be still alive - [[Grommik Kurthson]] - who tuned out to be living on the planet, became the team's new lead in their investigation.<ref name="timely arrival" />

Fauler's associate traveled to [[Grommik's Residence]] to talk to an old man, and in exchange for information agreed to help him fix some of his equipment. Soon after, they got ambushed by [[Czerka Assassin droids|assassin droids]] sent by [[Gayem Leksende]], who himself appeared via a hologram to intimidate his adversaries. The spacer managed to deal with the droids, and Gayem bombarded the farm from his airship. However, Grommik's residence had a specially designed safe room, which protected both Grommik and his guest from bombardment. Grommik then gave the spacer coordinates of several data caches he hid across the desert, which could help in discovering Czerka's [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|old base]].<ref name="last one out">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Last One Out|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

With data caches found, the spacer returned to [[Fauler]], who, together with [[Kamus Orden]], relocated to a [[SIS forward outpost|SIS forward base]] at the [[Outpost Salara|Salara outpost]]. The data revealed the rough location of the Czerka compound, but since the sands have significantly shifted over the last few decades, it was decided to scan the area with [[Terrain scanner/Legends|ground scanners]] to reconstruct the exact contemporary location. Fauler's associate took the scanner into [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]]'s territory and proceeded with the geological survey. An energy signature revealed in the process pointed to a nearby cloaked installation, and upon investigating, the spacer discovered a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Czerka listening outpost|listening outpost]], from which [[Gayem Leksende]] could spy on the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] progress. The spacer destroyed the data relay at the outpost and headed back to Fauler, to analyze the geological data.<ref name="Field Trip">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Field Trip|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

After analyzing the scans, Fauler and his team were able to locate the lost [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]]'s [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|facility]]. He explained to his new associate how to get the needed door codes from old Czerka relays scattered across the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], and waited for them at the [[SIS forward outpost|SIS base]]. Apart from codes, the relays stored old journal logs, which provided insights into what was happening at the facility decades ago, revealing that after an incident involving an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[mind prison]], all personnel stationed at the research base was transformed into cyber-necrotic mindless puppets for the will of the [[The Imprisoned One|One Imprisoned]] in the device. By the [[3643 BBY]] the compound was still overrun with augmented walking dead, and Fauler's associate, leading a strike team into the compound, had to make their way through their hordes.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|The Thing Czerka Found|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

[[Gayem Leksende]], using the information he already got from his [[Czerka listening outpost|listening post]], followed Fauler's associate closely. He waited for them to dispatch Rakatan's mind-controlled forces, after which took his chance to appear. Gayem was willing to offer a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if the SIS team gave him the [[Mind prison|mind prison]], as well as promising to lift the kill order on [[Kamus Orden]]. The team refused and attempted to destroy the device which angered Gayem. He and his bodyguards engaged the team and were both killed. Believeing to have destroyed the dangerous artifact, Fauler's associate returned to the [[SIS forward outpost|SIS outpost]], conveying the news of their success.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
The encounter with [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] technology was recorded and studied by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]]. Years later, a SIS agent [[Theron Shan]] was familiar with Rakata from [[Fauler]]'s report.<ref name="FAIII">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Forged Alliances, Part III|Carrick Station and Manaan}}</ref> Following Czerka's defeat on Tatooine, Fauler took [[Kamus Orden]] to Coruscant, where he testified against the crimes of the Corporation.<ref name="mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Life after Czerka!|Kamus Orden}}</ref> Allegations added to an already long lasting discussion of Czerka's corporate ethics, ultimately resulting in Czerka's reorganization in [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Titans">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=flashpoint|Titans of Industry}}</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
This article represent the events of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] planetary quest chain on Tatooine from [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Throughout the subsequent missions, on two instances does a player has branching options; assumed not chosen dark-side choices include hurting [[Grommik Kurthson|Grommik]] to get his information instead of helping him with his equipment and siding with [[Gayem Leksende|Gayem]] at the end, giving [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[mind prison]] to him for credits.
